items.question: Are all halls declared to be pavilion-shaped in this temple architecture rule?
items.inference: The verse states that every hall is declared to take pavilion form.
uncertainties: isolated verse leaves exact syntactic role of sarvaṃ partly open
maṇṭapākāraṃ may be read as complement or apposition
items.plain_english: All the halls are declared to be pavilion-shaped.
